newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Resolute in A$150 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Resolute in A$150 mln placement.

text.p: Gold explorer and producer Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to place 60 million shares at a price of A$2.50 per share to raise A$150 million.
Resolute said the shares would be placed to institutional clients of Prudential Bache Securities Ltd and Hartley Poynton Ltd.

The company said funds raised from the placement would be used to provide equity capital for the development of the Bulong Nickel project and to augment the company's working capital requirements for its gold development and exploration activities.
The placement is subject to shareholder approval.
